text: *1. Scanned copy of passport (passport photo first page and China visa page) **2. Document photo with white background *3. Highest degree certificate*4. High school transcripts *5. Personal Statement (Download the BIT International Student Personal Statement at https://isc.bit.edu.cn/→Resources→Download) template, fill in and upload to the application system attachment) 6. Application Materials for Student under 18 must be uploaded (if you are under 18, please Download Application materials for Student under 18 and upload all materials as required) 7. Physical Examination Form (please Download the Physical Examination Record for Foreigner in the "Download" section above, and upload the materials after going to the hospital for physical examination as required) 8. Financial security certificate (bank deposit certificate) 9. No crime certificate (to be issued at the local police station) 10. Other attachments (* is required)
